text: FAQ - Guest Reservations An independent travel network Groups (9+ Rooms) Travel Guides My Booking English Call now (888) 784-0547 (888) 784-0547 FAQ Where Can I Read Guest Reservations™ Customer Reviews? At GuestReservations.com, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We are obsessed with the customer experience and dedicated to providing the best service in the travel industry. For real, verified customer reviews, visit the GuestReservations.com reviews page on Shopper Approved . Can I Book By Phone? Absolutely! We have experienced agents standing by 24/7 to assist with your travel needs. Please call (888) 784-0547 for help with your booking. Is There A Change Or Cancellation Fee? It depends on your rate type. Non-refundable bookings cannot be changed or cancelled. Refundable bookings can be cancelled and rebooked for new dates by calling (888) 784-0547 . Check your confirmation receipt for any fee specific to your reservation and your cancellation deadline. I Canceled - When Should I Expect My Refund? Reservations cancelled online prior to the published cancellation policy date typically take 7 - 10 business days to post back to your account. However, some refunds can take up to 30 days or the next cycle to post to your credit card statement, depending on your financial institution. I Want A Refund Or Credit - Who Do I Contact? Call (888) 784-0547 , available 24/7. Refund and credit eligibility depends on your rate and applicable fees. Certain rates and fees are non-refundable and not eligible for credit. Refer to your confirmation receipt or reservation details for the cancellation policy that applies to your booking. I'm Having Trouble With My Online Booking - What Should I Do? First, check that your card details, billing zip code, and browser are current, and try refreshing the page or switching browsers if payment won't process. If the issue continues, call (888) 784-0547 to complete your booking with a sales representative. How To Use A Promo Code? We're issuing promo codes to select customers. If qualified for one, you'll get an email that explains the details. In the email you should receive the promo code which will provide you with the discount code for your booking, if applicable. Each promo code is valid for the time period indicated in the promotion received. Take the below steps to apply the promo code: Click on the link in the email to make a booking. Search for a hotel for your desired dates or location. At Checkout, click on the Use a promo code link, enter the provided promo code and click Apply . If the promo code is valid, you will see the final payment updated and discount applied to the nightly room rate (not including fees or taxes). Additional Details: You can’t apply a promo code after you book: Even if you contact Guestreservations.com support, we can’t apply a current or expired promo code after you’ve booked a reservation (future or past). The promo code also can’t be used if you change or cancel your original booking. Expiration dates can’t be adjusted: Once a promo code has expired, it’s not possible to extend the expiration date or to get a replacement promo code. Expired promo codes can't be used again. Limit one promo code per reservation: There’s no way to apply multiple promo codes for a single reservation. Discount amounts vary: Your final discount will vary and be displayed in your booking summary at checkout. The promo amount may depend on, for example, the total booking amount. There is no independent value to a promo code. You can’t exchange it, sell it, or get a refund for it. There is no discount on any taxes or fees. Promo codes are subject to terms: Promo codes have certain restrictions outlined with each email or code and are also subject to our Terms of Service . Codes will be voided or invalidated if you engage in fraud or violate any terms. If you are using a mobile device, message and data rates may apply. What Are Your Customer Service Hours? Customer Service is available 24/7 to answer questions about reservations or assist with booking. Call anytime at (888) 784-0547 . I Had A Problem At The Property – Who Can Help? If you had a problem at the property, please contact the property directly. If you need to contact us, please call (888) 784-0547 and follow the voice prompts. Is My Payment And Personal Information Secure? Yes. We use standard encryption technology to protect your credit card and personal details during checkout. See our Privacy Policy for full details. What If I Do Not See The Hotel I Want? Often we have special deals in the call center that are not available online. Try calling one of our sales representatives at (888) 784-0547 and follow the voice prompts for making a new booking, or keep checking back with us as we are constantly adding new hotels. I Have A Group - Who Do I Contact? Visit our Group Bookings page to request group hotel rates, or call 1-800-906-2871 for assistance. What credit cards do you accept? We accept American Express, Visa, MasterCard, and Discover. How Do I Get Address And Directions To The Property? To obtain the address and or driving directions to the hotel, we suggest going directly to Google Maps or by contacting the hotel directly. How Do I Book More Than 1 Room? When booking a room, click on the drop down menu for rooms and you will be given the option to select up to 8 rooms or 9+ rooms. Note: GuestReservations.com along with most properties consider 9 or more rooms to be a group reservation request. Can I Book For Someone Else? Yes, you are welcome to book for someone else if authorized. Please remember to make sure you put the correct guest name and input a contact phone number for the traveler. Will I Receive Frequent Stay Points? Some hotels offer points and some do not. We recommend that you inquire about points when you arrive at the hotel. How Do I Get My Confirmation Number? An email confirmation is emailed to you after booking or you may click the 'My Reservations' link at the top of the page for more itinerary information. I Did Not Receive An Email Confirmation - What Should I Do? Please check your spam or promotions folder, as confirmation emails sometimes can get filtered there. If you still can't find it, call (888) 784-0547 and we'll confirm your booking. What Do I Need To Give The Property On Check-In? Most properties will require you provide a photo-ID along with a credit card for incidentals. For certain rates, such as senior, corporate, or government discounts, and for certain properties, you may need additional documentation, depending on your reservation. Can I Change My Reservation During My Stay? Reservations can't be changed once booked. You can cancel your reservation either online at GuestReservations.com or by calling our customer service number at (888) 784-0547 and following the voice prompts. You may add a night to an existing reservation by creating a new reservation for your requested nights. If you have an emergency during your stay that the property is unable to resolve, call (888) 784-0547 for assistance. What If I Forget To Cancel The Booking? If you do not cancel your reservation, you will be charged for the entire stay. Do You Charge My Credit Card When Booking? Yes, all reservations booked on GuestReservations.com are considered a prepaid purchase and your credit card is charged in full at the time the booking is made. How Do I Submit Special Room Request For Bedding, Smoking Preference, Connecting Rooms, Etc.? Send an email to us through our contact page with the booking number, guest name, dates of stay and your preferences, and we will submit this request to the property. Please note all requests are based on the hotel’s availability and are not guaranteed. Is The Room Rate Per Person Or Per Night? All rates displayed are nightly and based on double occupancy per room unless otherwise specified. Carefully review the room descriptions and rate rules to ensure the room you select can accommodate your entire party. Any extra adults or children above the room’s listed occupancy may be subject to additional charges at the property’s discretion. Some rates may require special identification. Our booking fees, taxes, and other surcharges imposed by the hotel are not included. I Should Receive A Discounted Rate -How Do I Get This? The rates displayed are the only rates available to GuestReservations.com for making reservations. These rates may include government, corporate, or senior discounts. You may need special documentation at check-in to confirm you are qualified to receive that rate. Please do not expect to receive such a rate at check-in without the proper identification even if you have selected to book it online. When Will My Reservation Be At The Hotel? “Special Internet (Promotional) Rates”: In some cases, your name will not appear at the hotel until 72 hours prior to your arrival date. Rest assured, GuestReservations.com guarantees your room is booked from a pre-negotiated block of inventory. If for some reason, the hotel is unable to locate your reservation at the time of check in, please call a customer service representative at (888) 784-0547 and follow the voice prompts for us to assist you. “Standard Rates”: Depending on your arrival date, it takes a minimum of 24 hours before your reservation details reach the properties’ reservations system. Again, rest assured, GuestReservations.com guarantees your room is booked from a pre-negotiated block of inventory.If for some reason, the hotel in unable to locate your reservation at the time of check in, please call a customer service representative at (888) 784-0547 and follow the voice prompts for us to assist you. Once I Have Made My Reservation, Will I Receive Any Written Confirmation From the Hotel? No. The email confirmation you receive from booking through GuestReservations.com is all you will need. It displays your GuestReservations.com Booking Number, the hotel information, the rate, confirmation number, and the hotel's cancellation policy. Is There A Hotel Shuttle Service To/From The Airport? Many hotels offer prepaid and complimentary shuttle service to and from the airport. If this is a service the property offers, you will need to confirm and make arrangements directly with the hotel. Keep in mind, additional charges may apply. Is Parking Available? Free Parking? Long-Term Parking? Long and short term parking rates vary by hotel. While many hotels offer free parking to their guests, many downtown and urban properties do charge a fee. Long-term parking is offered at the discretion of the property (often in conjunction with park and fly rates). What If There Will Be More Than Two Adults In The Room? Most hotels allow additional guests to stay in the rooms for an additional charge (e.g. typically between $5.00-$20.00 per person). Please note most hotels will have maximum occupancy requirements based on bedding and room type. Our Children Will Be With Us - Do They Stay Free? Although this varies by property, typically children under 12 years of age stay for free in their parents’ room using the existing bedding. Note: it is important to disclose all the occupants in your party and disclose their ages upon request as it may impact the reservation. Are Rollaway Beds/Cribs Available? Most hotels offer rollaway beds and cribs (typically at a charge $5.00 - $20.00 each), but it varies by property. Some may have restrictions on what room types will allow rollaway beds. Is Breakfast Included? This varies by hotel and while many hotels offer free breakfast, we encourage you to review the descriptions or contact the property prior to check in. Breakfast options typically range from continental to buffet or full service. Do Hotels Have Minimum Age Requirements? Please be aware that most hotels may have minimum age restrictions or requirements when reserving a room. For example, some hotels with casinos may require you to be 21 years of age to check into a room. GuestReservations.com requires you to be a minimum of 18 years of age to book a reservation. If in doubt, feel free to contact one of our customer service representatives or contact the property directly. Do Hotels Have Health And Safety Policies I Should Know About? Some hotels may have specific health and safety policies, which vary by property and location. Please contact the hotel directly before check-in with any questions about its current requirements. Is GuestReservations.com Affiliated With The Hotel? Guest Reservations is an independent travel network and is not affiliated with individual hotels. Through established travel distribution channels, it provides customers access to rates and availability at more than 100,000 hotels worldwide. Does pricing differ from booking directly with the hotel? Guest Reservations presents available information about the room, price, amenities and booking terms. Because hotel inventory and rates can vary by source and timing, the offer shown on Guest Reservations may differ from an offer available through another platform or directly from the hotel. What Happens If The Hotel Cancels Or Can't Honor My Reservation? Reservations made through Guest Reservations are confirmed and valid once a booking confirmation is issued. If you experience an issue at the hotel, contact customer service for assistance and support at (888) 784-0547 . Can I Contact You By Email Or Chat Instead Of Phone? Guest Reservations provides support by phone so our customer service team can verify booking details, understand the issue and assist in real time. Email and chat support are not currently available. Can I Correct A Misspelled Guest Name After Booking? For assistance updating a misspelled name on a reservation, please contact customer support at (888) 784-0547 .
